source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Login BMC ,clear all logs.
2. Check health Led should be green.
3. make a error log (ex: remove one HDD)
4. Check health LED should change to orange/red color.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: make sure your heakth LED status can match status.

original_test_intent: Prove that the physical BMC health LED follows healthy and injected storage-fault states and returns after recovery.
original_method: An engineer observes the LED, removes a designated HDD to create a fault, correlates BMC/SEL/storage health, restores the drive and observes recovery.
manual_activity: The core acceptance requires an engineer to perform the physical drive action and visually verify the chassis health LED; the agent can only prepare and organize supporting logs/photos.
required_inputs: Safe drive slot and storage redundancy/backup
safety_requirements: Never remove an OS, mounted, in-use or protected drive without explicit authorization.
Confirm redundancy, backup and exact slot before removal.
Reject BurnIn as a substitute for the specified storage fault.
Stop on array/data risk; no automatic retry; preserve original logs.
agent_execution_scope: Collect BMC/SEL/storage state before and after engineer actions; organize time-correlated photo evidence.
Do not remove storage, assert visual observation or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform the physical fault/recovery; observe LED colors.
Own data protection and final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: BurnInTest does not create or prove the specified health-monitor storage fault and is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented read-only BMC/SEL and storage-health queries only as supporting evidence for the manual LED test.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Green then orange/red LED states, HDD example, script and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select a safe redundant drive, record healthy LED/state, perform approved removal, correlate LED/BMC/SEL/RAID state, reinsert/rebuild and prove recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis LED and storage topology.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor health LED and drive hot-service SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds slot/data protection and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Keeps physical LED acceptance and rejects load-only substitution.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED matrix and safe storage fault plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Drive removal can cause data loss or array degradation.

project_override_considerations: A different safe fault may be approved, but the project must prove it drives the same health state and record the change.
expected_evidence: LED matrix and approved fault target
Fault-state LED photo plus BMC/SEL/RAID evidence
